clues: This city sits in the northwest of its state in southern Germany, where two rivers meet. The larger river is the famous Rhine.
This city lies in a flat river plain that is the warmest part of the whole country. Forests rise on both sides of the plain.
The first long car trip in history started and ended in this city. A special road route now follows that same drive.
Most streets in its centre have no names at all. People find their way using blocks named with a letter and a number.
The car, the bicycle and the tractor were all invented here. That is why this place is known as the city of inventions.
